moments.author: LeBron James
moments.quote: I still truly love this game, and I have more to give … I believe I can help make the Philadelphia 76ers a championship team
moments.why: LeBron announcing his signing with the Sixers is dominating sports chatter—and X—right now.

moments.author: Jaylen Brown
moments.why: Jaylen Brown’s simple hashtag immediately captured fans’ excitement at joining forces with LeBron.

moments.author: Governor Josh Shapiro
moments.quote: I hereby proclaim today to be LEBRON JAMES DAY. Welcome to the City of Brotherly Love, @KingJames.
moments.why: Even the Pennsylvania governor weighed in—highlighting how LeBron’s move isn’t just sports, it’s civic drama.

moments.author: Saquon Barkley
moments.quote: Welcome to the city! Let me know when you tryna tee it up 🏌🏽⛳️ @KingJames
moments.why: NFL star Saquon joining the welcoming committee—shows tone-setting crossover hype beyond basketball.

moments.author: NBC Sports Philadelphia
moments.why: The regional sports network’s post crystallized the moment and amplified local fan mania.
